title: "Defence systems and biosynthetic gene clusters"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

```{r}
############################################################
# DATA PREPARATION: DEFENSE SYSTEMS AND BGCs
############################################################

rm(list = ls())

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


############################################################
# 1. WORKING DIRECTORY
############################################################

setwd(
  "/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Supplementary/BGC_DefenceMechanisms/"
)


############################################################
# 2. LOAD DEFENSEFINDER AND ANTISMASH RESULTS
############################################################

# Species-level summaries
defence <- read_tsv(
  "DefenseFinder_species_summary.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID)
  )


bgc <- read_tsv(
  "AntiSMASH_species_summary.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID)
  )


# Gene-level DefenseFinder inventory
defence_genes <- read_tsv(
  "DefenseFinder_gene_inventory.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID),
    Protein_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Protein_ID),
    Protein_ID = sub("-contig-", "-contig_", Protein_ID, fixed = TRUE)
  )


# Gene-level antiSMASH inventory
bgc_genes <- read_tsv(
  "AntiSMASH_BGC_gene_inventory.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID),

    # Retain the original antiSMASH identifier for traceability
    AntiSMASH_Protein_ID = Protein_ID,

    # Convert:
    # NZE01APR2102.contig-14980-cds52
    # into:
    # NZE01APR2102.MAG_346-contig_14980-cds52
    Protein_ID = paste0(
      Species_ID,
      "-contig_",
      sub("^.*contig[-_]", "", AntiSMASH_Protein_ID)
    )
  )


############################################################
# 3. LOAD SPECIES, GENE AND PROTEIN TABLES
############################################################

species <- read_csv(
  "../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Meta_Table.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID)
  )


genes <- read_csv(
  "../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Gene_Table.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID),
    Protein_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Protein_ID),
    Protein_ID = sub("-contig-", "-contig_", Protein_ID, fixed = TRUE)
  )


proteins <- read_csv(
  "../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Protein_Table.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID),
    Protein_ID = sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Protein_ID),
    Protein_ID = sub("-contig-", "-contig_", Protein_ID, fixed = TRUE)
  )


############################################################
# 4. PREPARE TAXONOMIC AND GENE-ANNOTATION LOOKUPS
############################################################

# One row per species containing all taxonomic, trophic and
# species-level proteomic information
species_lookup <- species %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)


# Relevant functional annotations for each predicted gene
gene_annotations <- genes %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    Contig_ID,

    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    KEGG_Category,
    KEGG_Subcategory_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory,

    COG_ID,
    COG_Annotation,
    TIGR_ID,
    TIGR_Annotation,
    PFAM_ID,
    PFAM_Annotation,
    PHOBIUS_Annotation,

    Transporter_Family,
    Substracte_Group,
    Substrate_Category,

    Protein_Length
  ) %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, Protein_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)


############################################################
# 5. SUMMARIZE METAPROTEOMIC DETECTION PER PROTEIN
############################################################

# The protein table contains repeated observations across dates.
# Summarize these first so that every predicted gene remains one
# row after joining.

n_proteomics_dates <- n_distinct(proteins$Date)


protein_expression <- proteins %>%
  mutate(
    Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species_ID, Protein_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    # TRUE if detected on at least one sampling date
    Detected_In_Proteome =
      any(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0),

    # Number of sampling dates with positive abundance
    N_Dates_Detected =
      n_distinct(Date[Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0]),

    # Mean across all proteomic dates, treating missing dates as zero
    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      sum(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm, na.rm = TRUE) /
      n_proteomics_dates,

    # Highest normalized abundance observed on any date
    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      max(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
# 6. ADD SPECIES INFORMATION TO SPECIES-LEVEL SUMMARIES
############################################################

defence <- defence %>%
  left_join(
    species_lookup,
    by = "Species_ID"
  )


bgc <- bgc %>%
  left_join(
    species_lookup,
    by = "Species_ID"
  )


############################################################
# 7. COMPLETE DEFENSE GENE/PROTEIN TABLE
############################################################

defence_gene_protein <- defence_genes %>%

  # Add KEGG, COG, TIGR and PFAM annotations
  left_join(
    gene_annotations,
    by = c("Species_ID", "Protein_ID")
  ) %>%

  # Add taxonomy and trophic strategy
  left_join(
    species_lookup,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%

  # Add metaproteomic detection and abundance
  left_join(
    protein_expression,
    by = c("Species_ID", "Protein_ID")
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    # Indicates whether the Protein_ID matched the gene table
    Gene_Annotation_Matched = !is.na(Contig_ID),

    # Missing proteins were not detected in the metaproteome
    Detected_In_Proteome =
      coalesce(Detected_In_Proteome, FALSE),

    N_Dates_Detected =
      coalesce(N_Dates_Detected, 0L),

    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm, 0),

    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm, 0)
  ) %>%

  relocate(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,

    Defense_Type,
    Defense_Subtype,
    Defense_System_ID,
    Defense_Gene,

    Domain,
    Phylum,
    Class,
    Order,
    Family,
    Genus,
    Species,

    TrophicIndex,
    TrophicGroup,
    Group_For_Plots,

    Detected_In_Proteome,
    N_Dates_Detected,
    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,

    Gene_Annotation_Matched,
    Contig_ID,
    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    KEGG_Category,
    KEGG_Subcategory_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory
  )


############################################################
# 8. COMPLETE BGC GENE/PROTEIN TABLE
############################################################

bgc_gene_protein <- bgc_genes %>%

  # Add KEGG, COG, TIGR and PFAM annotations
  left_join(
    gene_annotations,
    by = c("Species_ID", "Protein_ID")
  ) %>%

  # Add taxonomy and trophic strategy
  left_join(
    species_lookup,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%

  # Add metaproteomic detection and abundance
  left_join(
    protein_expression,
    by = c("Species_ID", "Protein_ID")
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    # Indicates whether the reconstructed antiSMASH ID matched
    # an entry in the gene table
    Gene_Annotation_Matched = !is.na(Contig_ID),

    Detected_In_Proteome =
      coalesce(Detected_In_Proteome, FALSE),

    N_Dates_Detected =
      coalesce(N_Dates_Detected, 0L),

    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm, 0),

    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm, 0)
  ) %>%

  relocate(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    AntiSMASH_Protein_ID,

    BGC_Type,
    BGC_Region,
    Contig_Edge,
    Gene_Kind,
    AntiSMASH_Gene_Functions,

    Domain,
    Phylum,
    Class,
    Order,
    Family,
    Genus,
    Species,

    TrophicIndex,
    TrophicGroup,
    Group_For_Plots,

    Detected_In_Proteome,
    N_Dates_Detected,
    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,

    Gene_Annotation_Matched,
    Contig_ID,
    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    KEGG_Category,
    KEGG_Subcategory_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory
  )


############################################################
# 9. FINAL DATA CHECK
############################################################

analysis_overview <- bind_rows(

  defence_gene_protein %>%
    summarise(
      Dataset = "DefenseFinder",
      N_Hit_Rows = n(),
      N_Unique_Genes = n_distinct(Protein_ID),
      N_Annotation_Matches = sum(Gene_Annotation_Matched),
      N_Proteins_Detected = sum(Detected_In_Proteome)
    ),

  bgc_gene_protein %>%
    summarise(
      Dataset = "antiSMASH BGC",
      N_Hit_Rows = n(),
      N_Unique_Genes = n_distinct(Protein_ID),
      N_Annotation_Matches = sum(Gene_Annotation_Matched),
      N_Proteins_Detected = sum(Detected_In_Proteome)
    )
)

analysis_overview
```



```{r}
############################################################
# ANTISMASH BGC GENE CLEANING
#
# CLEANING AND CONFIDENCE RULES
# --------------------------------
# antiSMASH does not use one universal minimum number of genes
# to call a BGC. Each BGC type has its own domain-combination
# and gene-proximity detection rule.
#
# REGION CONFIDENCE:
# - High: at least one antiSMASH biosynthetic/rule-based gene
#         was recovered and the region is not at a contig edge.
# - Moderate: at least one biosynthetic/rule-based gene was
#             recovered, but the region is at a contig edge
#             and may therefore be incomplete.
# - Excluded: no biosynthetic/rule-based gene was recovered
#             from the region inventory. These regions are
#             retained in the audit table for inspection.
#
# GENE RETENTION:
# - Retained: biosynthetic, biosynthetic-additional, transport,
#             regulatory and resistance genes assigned by
#             antiSMASH.
# - Excluded from the clean BGC-gene table: Gene_Kind "other"
#             or missing. These genes lie inside the extended
#             antiSMASH region but have no antiSMASH evidence
#             of BGC involvement. They remain in the audit table.
#
# KEGG/COG/PFAM annotations are not used to decide BGC
# membership. They are retained for biological interpretation.
#
# Protein abundance is also not used to decide BGC membership.
# Abundance > 0 only indicates detection in the metaproteome.
############################################################


############################################################
# 1. DEFINE THE THREE ANALYSIS GROUPS
############################################################

group_levels <- c(
  "Oligo_like",
  "Intermediate",
  "Copio_like"
)


############################################################
# 2. CLASSIFY ALL GENES IN THE ANTISMASH REGIONS
############################################################

bgc_gene_classified <- bgc_gene_protein %>%

  filter(
    Group_For_Plots %in% group_levels
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    BGC_Region_ID = paste(
      Species_ID,
      BGC_Region,
      sep = "__"
    ),

    # Explicit rule-based antiSMASH function
    Rule_Based_Biosynthetic_Gene =
      grepl(
        "biosynthetic \\(rule-based-clusters\\)",
        coalesce(
          AntiSMASH_Gene_Functions,
          ""
        ),
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ),

    # Core biosynthetic gene according to antiSMASH
    Core_Biosynthetic_Gene =
      Gene_Kind == "biosynthetic" |
      Rule_Based_Biosynthetic_Gene,

    # Additional secondary-metabolism gene
    Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene =
      Gene_Kind == "biosynthetic-additional" |
      grepl(
        "biosynthetic-additional",
        coalesce(
          AntiSMASH_Gene_Functions,
          ""
        ),
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ),

    # Possible transport, regulation or resistance function
    Accessory_BGC_Gene =
      Gene_Kind %in% c(
        "transport",
        "regulatory",
        "resistance"
      ),

    # Keep core, additional and accessory BGC genes
    Keep_As_BGC_Gene =
      Core_Biosynthetic_Gene |
      Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene |
      Accessory_BGC_Gene,

    # Compact gene-evidence classification
    BGC_Gene_Evidence = case_when(
      Core_Biosynthetic_Gene ~
        "Core biosynthetic",

      Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene ~
        "Additional biosynthetic",

      Accessory_BGC_Gene ~
        "Accessory BGC gene",

      TRUE ~
        "Neighbourhood only"
    ),

    # Protein detected with normalized abundance > 0
    Proteome_Detected =
      coalesce(
        Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
        0
      ) > 0,

    # Used only when duplicate gene-region records occur
    Gene_Evidence_Order = case_when(
      Core_Biosynthetic_Gene ~ 1L,
      Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene ~ 2L,
      Accessory_BGC_Gene ~ 3L,
      TRUE ~ 4L
    )
  ) %>%

  # If duplicate records exist, retain the strongest
  # antiSMASH gene assignment.
  arrange(
    Gene_Evidence_Order
  ) %>%

  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    BGC_Region,
    BGC_Type,
    Protein_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


############################################################
# 3. ASSESS EACH ANTISMASH REGION
############################################################

bgc_region_assessment <- bgc_gene_classified %>%

  group_by(
    Group_For_Plots,
    Species_ID,
    BGC_Region_ID,
    BGC_Region,
    BGC_Type,
    Contig_Edge
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    # All genes inside the antiSMASH region boundary
    N_All_Genes_In_Region =
      n_distinct(Protein_ID),

    # Genes retained as BGC genes
    N_BGC_Genes =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[Keep_As_BGC_Gene]
      ),

    # Core biosynthetic genes
    N_Core_Biosynthetic_Genes =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[Core_Biosynthetic_Gene]
      ),

    # Additional biosynthetic genes
    N_Additional_Biosynthetic_Genes =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene]
      ),

    # Transport, regulatory and resistance genes
    N_Accessory_BGC_Genes =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[Accessory_BGC_Gene]
      ),

    # Neighbouring genes excluded from BGC interpretation
    N_Neighbourhood_Genes_Excluded =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[!Keep_As_BGC_Gene]
      ),

    # Proteomic detection of retained BGC genes
    N_BGC_Proteins_Detected =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Keep_As_BGC_Gene &
          Proteome_Detected
        ]
      ),

    # Stronger evidence: core biosynthetic protein detected
    N_Core_Proteins_Detected =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Core_Biosynthetic_Gene &
          Proteome_Detected
        ]
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    # A retained region must contain at least one gene that
    # antiSMASH classified as biosynthetic/rule-based.
    Keep_Region =
      N_Core_Biosynthetic_Genes >= 1,

    Region_Confidence = case_when(
      !Keep_Region ~
        "Excluded: no core biosynthetic gene recovered",

      is.na(Contig_Edge) ~
        "Moderate: core present, edge status unknown",

      Contig_Edge ~
        "Moderate: core present, contig edge",

      TRUE ~
        "High: core present, non-edge"
    ),

    Percent_BGC_Genes_Detected =
      if_else(
        N_BGC_Genes > 0,
        100 *
          N_BGC_Proteins_Detected /
          N_BGC_Genes,
        0
      ),

    Region_Proteomic_Support = case_when(
      N_Core_Proteins_Detected > 0 ~
        "Core biosynthetic protein detected",

      N_BGC_Proteins_Detected > 0 ~
        "Only additional/accessory protein detected",

      TRUE ~
        "No BGC protein detected"
    )
  )


############################################################
# 4. ADD REGION CONFIDENCE TO EVERY GENE
############################################################

bgc_gene_assessed <- bgc_gene_classified %>%

  left_join(
    bgc_region_assessment %>%
      select(
        Species_ID,
        BGC_Region,
        BGC_Type,

        Keep_Region,
        Region_Confidence,
        Region_Proteomic_Support,

        N_All_Genes_In_Region,
        N_BGC_Genes,
        N_Core_Biosynthetic_Genes,
        N_Additional_Biosynthetic_Genes,
        N_Accessory_BGC_Genes,
        N_Neighbourhood_Genes_Excluded,

        N_BGC_Proteins_Detected,
        N_Core_Proteins_Detected,
        Percent_BGC_Genes_Detected
      ),

    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "BGC_Region",
      "BGC_Type"
    )
  )


############################################################
# 5. CLEAN GENE TABLE READY FOR ANALYSIS
############################################################

# Retain:
# - regions containing at least one biosynthetic/core gene
# - genes with an antiSMASH biosynthetic or accessory role
#
# Neighbourhood-only genes such as an unrelated LivK are
# excluded here but remain available in the audit table below.

bgc_gene_clean <- bgc_gene_assessed %>%

  filter(
    Keep_Region,
    Keep_As_BGC_Gene
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    Group_For_Plots,
    Species_ID,
    BGC_Region,
    Gene_Evidence_Order,
    Protein_ID
  ) %>%

  relocate(
    Species_ID,
    Group_For_Plots,

    Domain,
    Phylum,
    Class,
    Order,
    Family,
    Genus,
    Species,

    BGC_Region_ID,
    BGC_Region,
    BGC_Type,
    Contig_Edge,
    Region_Confidence,

    Protein_ID,
    Gene_Kind,
    BGC_Gene_Evidence,
    AntiSMASH_Gene_Functions,

    Proteome_Detected,
    N_Dates_Detected,
    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
    Region_Proteomic_Support,

    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    KEGG_Category,
    KEGG_Subcategory_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory,

    COG_ID,
    COG_Annotation,
    TIGR_ID,
    TIGR_Annotation,
    PFAM_ID,
    PFAM_Annotation,

    N_All_Genes_In_Region,
    N_BGC_Genes,
    N_Core_Biosynthetic_Genes,
    N_Additional_Biosynthetic_Genes,
    N_Accessory_BGC_Genes,
    N_Neighbourhood_Genes_Excluded,
    N_BGC_Proteins_Detected,
    N_Core_Proteins_Detected,
    Percent_BGC_Genes_Detected
  ) %>%

  select(
    -Gene_Evidence_Order,
    -Keep_As_BGC_Gene,
    -Keep_Region
  )


############################################################
# 6. REGION TABLE READY FOR LATER ANALYSIS
############################################################

bgc_region_clean <- bgc_region_assessment %>%

  filter(
    Keep_Region
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    Group_For_Plots,
    Species_ID,
    BGC_Region
  )


############################################################
# 7. AUDIT TABLE: EVERYTHING EXCLUDED
############################################################

# Nothing is silently deleted. This table contains:
# - neighbouring/passenger genes from retained regions
# - every gene from a region without a recovered core gene

bgc_gene_excluded <- bgc_gene_assessed %>%

  filter(
    !Keep_Region |
    !Keep_As_BGC_Gene
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    Exclusion_Reason = case_when(
      !Keep_Region ~
        paste(
          "Region excluded because no antiSMASH",
          "biosynthetic/core gene was recovered"
        ),

      !Keep_As_BGC_Gene ~
        paste(
          "Gene excluded because antiSMASH classified it",
          "as other or provided no BGC-related gene role"
        )
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    Group_For_Plots,
    Species_ID,
    BGC_Region,
    Protein_ID
  )


############################################################
# 8. CLEANING SUMMARY
############################################################

bgc_cleaning_summary <- bind_rows(

  bgc_gene_assessed %>%
    summarise(
      Table = "All genes inside antiSMASH regions",
      N_Rows = n(),
      N_Regions = n_distinct(BGC_Region_ID),
      N_Genes = n_distinct(Protein_ID)
    ),

  bgc_gene_clean %>%
    summarise(
      Table = "Genes retained for BGC analysis",
      N_Rows = n(),
      N_Regions = n_distinct(BGC_Region_ID),
      N_Genes = n_distinct(Protein_ID)
    ),

  bgc_gene_excluded %>%
    summarise(
      Table = "Excluded audit rows",
      N_Rows = n(),
      N_Regions = n_distinct(BGC_Region_ID),
      N_Genes = n_distinct(Protein_ID)
    )
)

bgc_cleaning_summary


############################################################
# 9. EXPORT THE CLEAN AND AUDIT SHEETS
############################################################

write_csv(
  bgc_gene_clean,
  "AntiSMASH_BGC_gene_clean.csv"
)

write_csv(
  bgc_gene_excluded,
  "AntiSMASH_BGC_gene_excluded_audit.csv"
)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# DEFENSEFINDER AND ANTISMASH DATA PREPARATION
# ANTISMASH CLEANING AND FINAL TWO-PANEL FIGURE
#
# ANALYSIS UNIVERSE
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Only MAGs present in BOTH the DefenseFinder and antiSMASH
# species summaries are retained throughout the analysis.
#
# ANTISMASH CLEANING
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Retained regions:
#   At least one antiSMASH core or rule-based biosynthetic
#   gene must be recovered.
#
# Retained genes:
#   - biosynthetic
#   - biosynthetic-additional
#   - transport
#   - regulatory
#   - resistance
#
# Excluded genes:
#   Genes classified as "other" or without an antiSMASH BGC
#   role. These can be neighbouring genes located inside the
#   extended antiSMASH region boundary.
#
# PANEL B LABELS
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# "n = ..." above each prevalence bar is the number of unique
# retained BGC-associated proteins detected in the metaproteome
# for that trophic strategy and BGC type.
#
# OUTPUTS
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. AntiSMASH_BGC_clean_gene_protein.csv
# 2. AntiSMASH_BGC_overview.pdf
# 3. AntiSMASH_BGC_overview.png
############################################################


############################################################
# 0. START CLEAN AND LOAD PACKAGES
############################################################

rm(list = ls())

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})


############################################################
# 1. WORKING DIRECTORY
############################################################

setwd(
  paste0(
    "/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/",
    "DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Supplementary/",
    "BGC_DefenceMechanisms/"
  )
)


############################################################
# 2. ANALYSIS AND PLOTTING SETTINGS
############################################################

group_levels <- c(
  "Oligo_like",
  "Intermediate",
  "Copio_like"
)

trophic_levels <- c(
  "Oligotroph",
  "Intermediate",
  "Copiotroph"
)

trophic_cols <- c(
  "Oligotroph"   = "#93C2E6",
  "Intermediate" = "#EDEAE9",
  "Copiotroph"   = "#BA5205"
)

output_directory <- "AntiSMASH_BGC_Overview"

dir.create(
  output_directory,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


############################################################
# 3. LOAD DEFENSEFINDER AND ANTISMASH RESULTS
############################################################

# Species-level summaries include species with zero predictions
defence_raw <- read_tsv(
  "DefenseFinder_species_summary.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID)
  )


bgc_raw <- read_tsv(
  "AntiSMASH_species_summary.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID)
  )


# Gene-level DefenseFinder inventory
defence_genes_raw <- read_tsv(
  "DefenseFinder_gene_inventory.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID),

    Protein_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Protein_ID),

    Protein_ID =
      sub(
        "-contig-",
        "-contig_",
        Protein_ID,
        fixed = TRUE
      )
  )


# Gene-level antiSMASH inventory
bgc_genes_raw <- read_tsv(
  "AntiSMASH_BGC_gene_inventory.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID),

    # Preserve the original antiSMASH identifier
    AntiSMASH_Protein_ID = Protein_ID,

    # Convert the antiSMASH ID into the format used by the
    # complete gene and protein tables
    Protein_ID = paste0(
      Species_ID,
      "-contig_",
      sub(
        "^.*contig[-_]",
        "",
        AntiSMASH_Protein_ID
      )
    )
  )


############################################################
# 4. LOAD SPECIES, GENE AND PROTEIN TABLES
############################################################

species_raw <- read_csv(
  "../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Meta_Table.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID)
  )


genes_raw <- read_csv(
  "../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Gene_Table.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID),

    Protein_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Protein_ID),

    Protein_ID =
      sub(
        "-contig-",
        "-contig_",
        Protein_ID,
        fixed = TRUE
      )
  )


proteins_raw <- read_csv(
  "../../Figure_03/LakeOverview/Species_Protein_Table.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Species_ID),

    Protein_ID =
      sub("\\.MAG-", ".MAG_", Protein_ID),

    Protein_ID =
      sub(
        "-contig-",
        "-contig_",
        Protein_ID,
        fixed = TRUE
      )
  )


############################################################
# 5. DEFINE THE COMMON ANALYSIS SPECIES
############################################################

# Intersection of the two species-level result tables
common_species_ids <- inner_join(
  defence_raw %>%
    distinct(Species_ID),

  bgc_raw %>%
    distinct(Species_ID),

  by = "Species_ID"
)


species_lookup_all <- species_raw %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


# Attach metadata and retain the three analysis groups
analysis_species <- common_species_ids %>%
  inner_join(
    species_lookup_all,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Group_For_Plots %in% group_levels
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group_For_Plots = factor(
      Group_For_Plots,
      levels = group_levels
    ),

    Trophic_Strategy = recode(
      as.character(Group_For_Plots),
      "Oligo_like"   = "Oligotroph",
      "Intermediate" = "Intermediate",
      "Copio_like"   = "Copiotroph"
    ),

    Trophic_Strategy = factor(
      Trophic_Strategy,
      levels = trophic_levels
    )
  )


analysis_species_ids <- analysis_species %>%
  distinct(Species_ID)


############################################################
# 6. VERIFY THE ANALYSIS UNIVERSE
############################################################

analysis_universe_summary <- tibble(
  Dataset = c(
    "DefenseFinder species summary",
    "antiSMASH species summary",
    "Species present in both summaries",
    "Common species in the three trophic groups"
  ),

  N_Species = c(
    n_distinct(defence_raw$Species_ID),
    n_distinct(bgc_raw$Species_ID),
    n_distinct(common_species_ids$Species_ID),
    n_distinct(analysis_species$Species_ID)
  )
)


analysis_group_sizes <- analysis_species %>%
  count(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    name = "N_MAGs"
  )


analysis_universe_summary
analysis_group_sizes

# Expected total: 170 MAGs
n_distinct(analysis_species$Species_ID)


############################################################
# 7. RESTRICT EVERY DATASET TO THE COMMON SPECIES
############################################################

defence <- defence_raw %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_ids,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_species,
    by = "Species_ID"
  )


bgc <- bgc_raw %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_ids,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    analysis_species,
    by = "Species_ID"
  )


defence_genes <- defence_genes_raw %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_ids,
    by = "Species_ID"
  )


bgc_genes <- bgc_genes_raw %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_ids,
    by = "Species_ID"
  )


genes <- genes_raw %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_ids,
    by = "Species_ID"
  )


proteins <- proteins_raw %>%
  semi_join(
    analysis_species_ids,
    by = "Species_ID"
  )


############################################################
# 8. PREPARE SPECIES AND GENE-ANNOTATION LOOKUPS
############################################################

species_lookup <- analysis_species %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


gene_annotations <- genes %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    Contig_ID,

    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    KEGG_Category,
    KEGG_Subcategory_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory,

    COG_ID,
    COG_Annotation,

    TIGR_ID,
    TIGR_Annotation,

    PFAM_ID,
    PFAM_Annotation,

    PHOBIUS_Annotation,

    Transporter_Family,
    Substracte_Group,
    Substrate_Category,

    Protein_Length
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


############################################################
# 9. SUMMARIZE METAPROTEOMIC DETECTION PER PROTEIN
############################################################

# The protein table contains repeated observations across dates.
# It is reduced to one row per predicted protein before joining.

n_proteomics_dates <- n_distinct(
  proteins$Date
)


protein_expression <- proteins %>%
  mutate(
    Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(
        Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
        0
      )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    # Detected on at least one sampling date
    Detected_In_Proteome =
      any(
        Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0
      ),

    N_Dates_Detected =
      n_distinct(
        Date[
          Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0
        ]
      ),

    # Mean across every metaproteomic date; missing dates
    # contribute zero abundance
    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      sum(
        Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) /
      n_proteomics_dates,

    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      max(
        Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
# 10. CONSOLIDATE THE DEFENSEFINDER GENE–PROTEIN TABLE
############################################################

defence_gene_protein <- defence_genes %>%
  left_join(
    gene_annotations,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Protein_ID"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    species_lookup,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    protein_expression,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Protein_ID"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_Annotation_Matched =
      !is.na(Contig_ID),

    Detected_In_Proteome =
      coalesce(
        Detected_In_Proteome,
        FALSE
      ),

    N_Dates_Detected =
      coalesce(
        N_Dates_Detected,
        0L
      ),

    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(
        Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
        0
      ),

    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(
        Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
        0
      )
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Group_For_Plots,

    Protein_ID,

    Defense_Type,
    Defense_Subtype,
    Defense_System_ID,
    Defense_Gene,

    Domain,
    Phylum,
    Class,
    Order,
    Family,
    Genus,
    Species,

    Detected_In_Proteome,
    N_Dates_Detected,
    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,

    Gene_Annotation_Matched,
    Contig_ID,

    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    KEGG_Category,
    KEGG_Subcategory_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory
  )


############################################################
# 11. CONSOLIDATE THE ANTISMASH GENE–PROTEIN TABLE
############################################################

bgc_gene_protein <- bgc_genes %>%
  left_join(
    gene_annotations,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Protein_ID"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    species_lookup,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    protein_expression,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Protein_ID"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_Annotation_Matched =
      !is.na(Contig_ID),

    Detected_In_Proteome =
      coalesce(
        Detected_In_Proteome,
        FALSE
      ),

    N_Dates_Detected =
      coalesce(
        N_Dates_Detected,
        0L
      ),

    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(
        Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
        0
      ),

    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm =
      coalesce(
        Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
        0
      )
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Group_For_Plots,

    Protein_ID,
    AntiSMASH_Protein_ID,

    BGC_Type,
    BGC_Region,
    Contig_Edge,
    Gene_Kind,
    AntiSMASH_Gene_Functions,

    Domain,
    Phylum,
    Class,
    Order,
    Family,
    Genus,
    Species,

    Detected_In_Proteome,
    N_Dates_Detected,
    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,

    Gene_Annotation_Matched,
    Contig_ID,

    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    KEGG_Category,
    KEGG_Subcategory_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory
  )


############################################################
# 12. CHECK IDENTIFIER MATCHING
############################################################

consolidation_summary <- bind_rows(
  defence_gene_protein %>%
    summarise(
      Dataset = "DefenseFinder",
      N_Rows = n(),
      N_Unique_Proteins =
        n_distinct(Protein_ID),
      N_Annotation_Matches =
        sum(Gene_Annotation_Matched),
      N_Proteins_Detected =
        sum(Detected_In_Proteome)
    ),

  bgc_gene_protein %>%
    summarise(
      Dataset = "antiSMASH",
      N_Rows = n(),
      N_Unique_Proteins =
        n_distinct(Protein_ID),
      N_Annotation_Matches =
        sum(Gene_Annotation_Matched),
      N_Proteins_Detected =
        sum(Detected_In_Proteome)
    )
)

consolidation_summary


############################################################
# 13. CLASSIFY GENES INSIDE ANTISMASH REGIONS
############################################################

bgc_gene_classified <- bgc_gene_protein %>%
  mutate(
    BGC_Region_ID = paste(
      Species_ID,
      BGC_Region,
      sep = "__"
    ),

    Rule_Based_Biosynthetic_Gene =
      str_detect(
        coalesce(
          AntiSMASH_Gene_Functions,
          ""
        ),
        regex(
          "biosynthetic \\(rule-based-clusters\\)",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ),

    Core_Biosynthetic_Gene =
      coalesce(Gene_Kind, "") ==
        "biosynthetic" |
      Rule_Based_Biosynthetic_Gene,

    Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene =
      coalesce(Gene_Kind, "") ==
        "biosynthetic-additional" |
      str_detect(
        coalesce(
          AntiSMASH_Gene_Functions,
          ""
        ),
        regex(
          "biosynthetic-additional",
          ignore_case = TRUE
        )
      ),

    Accessory_BGC_Gene =
      coalesce(Gene_Kind, "") %in% c(
        "transport",
        "regulatory",
        "resistance"
      ),

    Keep_As_BGC_Gene =
      Core_Biosynthetic_Gene |
      Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene |
      Accessory_BGC_Gene,

    BGC_Gene_Evidence = case_when(
      Core_Biosynthetic_Gene ~
        "Core biosynthetic",

      Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene ~
        "Additional biosynthetic",

      Accessory_BGC_Gene ~
        "Accessory BGC gene",

      TRUE ~
        "Neighbourhood only"
    ),

    Proteome_Detected =
      coalesce(
        Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
        0
      ) > 0,

    Gene_Evidence_Order = case_when(
      Core_Biosynthetic_Gene ~ 1L,
      Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene ~ 2L,
      Accessory_BGC_Gene ~ 3L,
      TRUE ~ 4L
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Gene_Evidence_Order
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    BGC_Region_ID,
    BGC_Type,
    Protein_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


############################################################
# 14. ASSESS EACH ANTISMASH REGION
############################################################

bgc_region_assessment <- bgc_gene_classified %>%
  group_by(
    Group_For_Plots,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Species_ID,
    BGC_Region_ID,
    BGC_Region,
    BGC_Type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Contig_Edge =
      first(Contig_Edge),

    N_All_Genes_In_Region =
      n_distinct(Protein_ID),

    N_BGC_Genes =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Keep_As_BGC_Gene
        ]
      ),

    N_Core_Biosynthetic_Genes =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Core_Biosynthetic_Gene
        ]
      ),

    N_Additional_Biosynthetic_Genes =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene
        ]
      ),

    N_Accessory_BGC_Genes =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Accessory_BGC_Gene
        ]
      ),

    N_Neighbourhood_Genes_Excluded =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          !Keep_As_BGC_Gene
        ]
      ),

    N_BGC_Proteins_Detected =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Keep_As_BGC_Gene &
            Proteome_Detected
        ]
      ),

    N_Core_Proteins_Detected =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Core_Biosynthetic_Gene &
            Proteome_Detected
        ]
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Keep_Region =
      N_Core_Biosynthetic_Genes >= 1,

    Region_Confidence = case_when(
      !Keep_Region ~
        "Excluded: no core biosynthetic gene recovered",

      is.na(Contig_Edge) ~
        "Moderate: core present, edge status unknown",

      Contig_Edge ~
        "Moderate: core present, contig edge",

      TRUE ~
        "High: core present, non-edge"
    ),

    Percent_BGC_Genes_Detected = if_else(
      N_BGC_Genes > 0,
      100 *
        N_BGC_Proteins_Detected /
        N_BGC_Genes,
      0
    ),

    Region_Proteomic_Support = case_when(
      N_Core_Proteins_Detected > 0 ~
        "Core biosynthetic protein detected",

      N_BGC_Proteins_Detected > 0 ~
        "Only additional/accessory protein detected",

      TRUE ~
        "No BGC protein detected"
    )
  )


############################################################
# 15. ADD REGION ASSESSMENT TO EACH GENE
############################################################

bgc_gene_assessed <- bgc_gene_classified %>%
  left_join(
    bgc_region_assessment %>%
      select(
        Species_ID,
        BGC_Region_ID,
        BGC_Type,

        Keep_Region,
        Region_Confidence,
        Region_Proteomic_Support,

        N_All_Genes_In_Region,
        N_BGC_Genes,
        N_Core_Biosynthetic_Genes,
        N_Additional_Biosynthetic_Genes,
        N_Accessory_BGC_Genes,
        N_Neighbourhood_Genes_Excluded,

        N_BGC_Proteins_Detected,
        N_Core_Proteins_Detected,
        Percent_BGC_Genes_Detected
      ),

    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "BGC_Region_ID",
      "BGC_Type"
    )
  )


############################################################
# 16. FINAL CLEAN BGC GENE–PROTEIN TABLE
############################################################

bgc_clean_gene_protein <- bgc_gene_assessed %>%
  filter(
    Keep_Region,
    Keep_As_BGC_Gene
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Species_ID,
    BGC_Region,
    Gene_Evidence_Order,
    Protein_ID
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Group_For_Plots,

    Domain,
    Phylum,
    Class,
    Order,
    Family,
    Genus,
    Species,

    BGC_Region_ID,
    BGC_Region,
    BGC_Type,
    Contig_Edge,
    Region_Confidence,

    Protein_ID,
    AntiSMASH_Protein_ID,

    Gene_Kind,
    BGC_Gene_Evidence,
    Rule_Based_Biosynthetic_Gene,
    Core_Biosynthetic_Gene,
    Additional_Biosynthetic_Gene,
    Accessory_BGC_Gene,
    AntiSMASH_Gene_Functions,

    Proteome_Detected,
    N_Dates_Detected,
    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
    Region_Proteomic_Support,

    Gene_Annotation_Matched,
    Contig_ID,

    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    KEGG_Category,
    KEGG_Subcategory_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory,

    COG_ID,
    COG_Annotation,
    TIGR_ID,
    TIGR_Annotation,
    PFAM_ID,
    PFAM_Annotation,

    N_All_Genes_In_Region,
    N_BGC_Genes,
    N_Core_Biosynthetic_Genes,
    N_Additional_Biosynthetic_Genes,
    N_Accessory_BGC_Genes,
    N_Neighbourhood_Genes_Excluded,
    N_BGC_Proteins_Detected,
    N_Core_Proteins_Detected,
    Percent_BGC_Genes_Detected
  ) %>%
  select(
    -Gene_Evidence_Order,
    -Keep_As_BGC_Gene,
    -Keep_Region
  )


# One row per retained region for plotting
bgc_region_clean <- bgc_region_assessment %>%
  filter(
    Keep_Region
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Species_ID,
    BGC_Region
  )


# Excluded rows remain available in R for auditing
bgc_gene_excluded <- bgc_gene_assessed %>%
  filter(
    !Keep_Region |
      !Keep_As_BGC_Gene
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Exclusion_Reason = case_when(
      !Keep_Region ~
        paste(
          "Region excluded because no antiSMASH",
          "core biosynthetic gene was recovered"
        ),

      !Keep_As_BGC_Gene ~
        paste(
          "Gene excluded because antiSMASH provided",
          "no BGC-related gene role"
        )
    )
  )


############################################################
# 17. CLEANING SUMMARY
############################################################

bgc_cleaning_summary <- bind_rows(
  bgc_gene_assessed %>%
    summarise(
      Table =
        "All genes inside antiSMASH regions",

      N_Rows = n(),
      N_Regions =
        n_distinct(BGC_Region_ID),
      N_Genes =
        n_distinct(Protein_ID)
    ),

  bgc_clean_gene_protein %>%
    summarise(
      Table =
        "Genes retained for BGC analysis",

      N_Rows = n(),
      N_Regions =
        n_distinct(BGC_Region_ID),
      N_Genes =
        n_distinct(Protein_ID)
    ),

  bgc_gene_excluded %>%
    summarise(
      Table =
        "Excluded audit rows",

      N_Rows = n(),
      N_Regions =
        n_distinct(BGC_Region_ID),
      N_Genes =
        n_distinct(Protein_ID)
    )
)

bgc_cleaning_summary


############################################################
# 18. EXPORT THE SINGLE CLEAN SCREENING TABLE
############################################################

write_csv(
  bgc_clean_gene_protein,
  file.path(
    output_directory,
    "AntiSMASH_BGC_clean_gene_protein.csv"
  )
)


############################################################
# 19. PREPARE PANEL A: RETAINED BGC REGIONS PER MAG
############################################################

# analysis_species is the authoritative denominator and
# therefore retains MAGs without a cleaned BGC region.

bgc_per_mag <- analysis_species %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    bgc_region_clean %>%
      count(
        Species_ID,
        Trophic_Strategy,
        name = "N_BGC_Regions"
      ),

    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Trophic_Strategy"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    N_BGC_Regions =
      replace_na(
        N_BGC_Regions,
        0L
      )
  )


group_sizes <- bgc_per_mag %>%
  count(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    name = "N_MAGs"
  )


# These counts should be 62, 94 and 14 and sum to 170
group_sizes
sum(group_sizes$N_MAGs)


trophic_axis_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(
    as.character(
      group_sizes$Trophic_Strategy
    ),
    "\n(n = ",
    group_sizes$N_MAGs,
    " MAGs)"
  ),

  as.character(
    group_sizes$Trophic_Strategy
  )
)


############################################################
# 20. PREPARE PANEL B: BGC-TYPE PREVALENCE AND PROTEINS
############################################################

# First calculate the number of regions and MAGs carrying each
# retained BGC type.

bgc_type_counts <- bgc_region_clean %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(BGC_Type),
    BGC_Type != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    BGC_Type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Regions = n(),

    N_MAGs_With_Type =
      n_distinct(Species_ID),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Count unique retained BGC-associated proteins for each type.
# A detected protein has normalized abundance > 0 on at least
# one metaproteomic date.

bgc_type_protein_counts <- bgc_clean_gene_protein %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(BGC_Type),
    BGC_Type != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    BGC_Type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Retained_BGC_Proteins =
      n_distinct(Protein_ID),

    N_Detected_BGC_Proteins =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Proteome_Detected
        ]
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Join the regional and protein summaries
bgc_type_counts <- bgc_type_counts %>%
  left_join(
    bgc_type_protein_counts,
    by = c(
      "Trophic_Strategy",
      "BGC_Type"
    )
  )


# Create every trophic-strategy × BGC-type combination so that
# absent types are explicitly represented by zero.

all_bgc_type_combinations <- expand_grid(
  Trophic_Strategy = trophic_levels,

  BGC_Type = sort(
    unique(
      bgc_type_counts$BGC_Type
    )
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Trophic_Strategy = factor(
      Trophic_Strategy,
      levels = trophic_levels
    )
  )


bgc_type_prevalence <- all_bgc_type_combinations %>%
  left_join(
    bgc_type_counts,
    by = c(
      "Trophic_Strategy",
      "BGC_Type"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    group_sizes,
    by = "Trophic_Strategy"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        N_Regions,
        N_MAGs_With_Type,
        N_Retained_BGC_Proteins,
        N_Detected_BGC_Proteins
      ),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    ),

    Percent_MAGs_With_Type =
      100 *
      N_MAGs_With_Type /
      N_MAGs,

    # Show a label only when the BGC type is present.
    # BGC types that are present but have no detected protein
    # are labelled n = 0.
    Detected_Protein_Label = if_else(
      N_Regions > 0,
      paste0(
        "n = ",
        N_Detected_BGC_Proteins
      ),
      ""
    ),

    # Position the label just beyond the end of the bar
    Protein_Label_Position =
      Percent_MAGs_With_Type + 1.5
  )


# Order BGC types from rarest to most widespread so that the
# most prevalent types appear at the top after coord_flip().

bgc_type_order <- bgc_type_prevalence %>%
  group_by(BGC_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_MAGs_With_Type =
      sum(N_MAGs_With_Type),

    Total_Regions =
      sum(N_Regions),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Total_MAGs_With_Type,
    Total_Regions
  ) %>%
  pull(BGC_Type)


bgc_type_prevalence <- bgc_type_prevalence %>%
  mutate(
    BGC_Type = factor(
      BGC_Type,
      levels = bgc_type_order
    )
  )


############################################################
# 21. PANEL A: VIOLIN PLOT WITH INDIVIDUAL MAGs
############################################################

maximum_regions <- max(
  bgc_per_mag$N_BGC_Regions,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


plot_regions_per_mag <- ggplot(
  bgc_per_mag,
  aes(
    x = Trophic_Strategy,
    y = N_BGC_Regions,
    fill = Trophic_Strategy
  )
) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = TRUE,
    scale = "width",
    adjust = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.75,
    colour = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.13,
    height = 0.05,
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.8,
    stroke = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.70,
    colour = "grey20"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3.2,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = trophic_cols
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = trophic_axis_labels
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:maximum_regions,
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.02, 0.08)
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(
      -0.12,
      maximum_regions + 0.4
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title =
      "Retained antiSMASH BGC regions per MAG",

    subtitle =
      "Dots represent individual MAGs; white diamonds show medians",

    x = NULL,

    y =
      "Number of retained BGC regions"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 9,
      colour = "grey30"
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


############################################################
# 22. PANEL B: NESTED BARS WITH DETECTED-PROTEIN COUNTS
############################################################

plot_bgc_prevalence <- ggplot(
  bgc_type_prevalence,
  aes(
    x = BGC_Type,
    y = Percent_MAGs_With_Type,
    fill = Trophic_Strategy
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge2(
      width = 0.85,
      preserve = "single",
      padding = 0.08
    ),
    width = 0.72,
    colour = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +

  # Protein counts use exactly the same dodging as the bars.
  # Labels are placed beyond the bar ends because the bars are
  # horizontal after coord_flip().
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = Protein_Label_Position,
      label = Detected_Protein_Label
    ),
    position = position_dodge2(
      width = 0.85,
      preserve = "single",
      padding = 0.08
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 2.4,
    colour = "grey15",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_flip(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = trophic_cols
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = function(x) {
      str_replace_all(
        x,
        "_",
        "-"
      )
    }
  ) +

  # Extra horizontal space is provided for protein labels.
  # Axis tick marks remain restricted to prevalence values
  # between 0% and 100%.
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 112),

    breaks = seq(
      0,
      100,
      20
    ),

    labels = function(x) {
      paste0(x, "%")
    },

    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title =
      "Prevalence of antiSMASH BGC types",

    subtitle =
      "Bars show MAG prevalence; labels show detected BGC-associated proteins",

    x = NULL,

    y =
      "MAGs containing BGC type",

    fill =
      "Trophic strategy"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 9,
      colour = "grey30"
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 7.5
    ),

    legend.position = "top",

    legend.title = element_blank(),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      colour = "grey92",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      5.5,
      16,
      5.5,
      5.5
    )
  )


############################################################
# 23. COMBINE AND EXPORT THE FINAL FIGURE
############################################################

bgc_overview_figure <- (
  plot_regions_per_mag |
    plot_bgc_prevalence
) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.85, 1.65),
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",

    title =
      "Biosynthetic gene-cluster potential across trophic strategies",

    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14
      ),

      plot.tag = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 13
      )
    )
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )


bgc_overview_figure


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_directory,
    "AntiSMASH_BGC_overview.pdf"
  ),
  plot = bgc_overview_figure,
  width = 13,
  height = 8,
  units = "in"
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    output_directory,
    "AntiSMASH_BGC_overview.png"
  ),
  plot = bgc_overview_figure,
  width = 13,
  height = 13,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# 20. PREPARE PANEL B: PREVALENCE AND PROTEIN DETECTION
############################################################

# Count retained regions and the number of MAGs containing
# each antiSMASH BGC type.
bgc_type_counts <- bgc_region_clean %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(BGC_Type),
    BGC_Type != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    BGC_Type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Regions = n(),

    N_MAGs_With_Type =
      n_distinct(Species_ID),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Count unique retained and detected BGC-associated proteins.
#
# The resulting figure label is:
#   (detected proteins / retained proteins)
#
# For example, (2/200) means that 2 of 200 retained proteins
# assigned to that BGC type were detected in the metaproteome.
bgc_type_protein_counts <- bgc_clean_gene_protein %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(BGC_Type),
    BGC_Type != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    BGC_Type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Retained_BGC_Proteins =
      n_distinct(Protein_ID),

    N_Detected_BGC_Proteins =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[
          Proteome_Detected
        ]
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Combine region, MAG and protein information
bgc_type_counts <- bgc_type_counts %>%
  left_join(
    bgc_type_protein_counts,
    by = c(
      "Trophic_Strategy",
      "BGC_Type"
    )
  )


# Create every trophic-strategy × BGC-type combination so that
# absent BGC types are explicitly represented by zero.
all_bgc_type_combinations <- expand_grid(
  Trophic_Strategy = trophic_levels,

  BGC_Type = sort(
    unique(
      bgc_type_counts$BGC_Type
    )
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Trophic_Strategy = factor(
      Trophic_Strategy,
      levels = trophic_levels
    )
  )


bgc_type_prevalence <- all_bgc_type_combinations %>%
  left_join(
    bgc_type_counts,
    by = c(
      "Trophic_Strategy",
      "BGC_Type"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    group_sizes,
    by = "Trophic_Strategy"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        N_Regions,
        N_MAGs_With_Type,
        N_Retained_BGC_Proteins,
        N_Detected_BGC_Proteins
      ),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    ),

    Percent_MAGs_With_Type =
      100 *
      N_MAGs_With_Type /
      N_MAGs,

    # Label only combinations where the BGC type occurs.
    # A present type without protein detection receives (0/x).
    Protein_Detection_Label = if_else(
      N_Regions > 0,
      paste0(
        "(",
        N_Detected_BGC_Proteins,
        "/",
        N_Retained_BGC_Proteins,
        ")"
      ),
      ""
    ),

    # Place the label just beyond the end of its bar
    Protein_Label_Position =
      Percent_MAGs_With_Type + 1
  )


# Order BGC types from rarest to most widespread.
# The most prevalent type appears at the top after coord_flip().
bgc_type_order <- bgc_type_prevalence %>%
  group_by(BGC_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_MAGs_With_Type =
      sum(N_MAGs_With_Type),

    Total_Regions =
      sum(N_Regions),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Total_MAGs_With_Type,
    Total_Regions
  ) %>%
  pull(BGC_Type)


bgc_type_prevalence <- bgc_type_prevalence %>%
  mutate(
    BGC_Type = factor(
      BGC_Type,
      levels = bgc_type_order
    )
  )


############################################################

    ),

    plot.margin = margin(

############################################################

bgc_overview_figure <- (

) +
```

```{r}
############################################################
# DEFENSEFINDER OVERVIEW
#
# PANEL A
#   Number of predicted defence systems per MAG.
#   Counts come from DefenseFinder_species_summary.tsv so that
#   all 170 MAGs, including zero-system MAGs, are retained.
#
# PANEL B
#   MAG prevalence of each DefenseFinder system type.
#   Labels show:
#       (detected / retained defence-associated proteins)
#
# EXPRESSION
#   A protein is detected when normalized iBAQ > 0 on at least
#   one metaproteomic sampling date.
#
# OUTPUTS
#   1. DefenseFinder_gene_protein_clean.csv
#   2. DefenseFinder_system_overview.csv
#   3. DefenseFinder_MAG_overview.csv
#   4. DefenseFinder_type_prevalence.csv
#   5. DefenseFinder_count_discrepancies.csv
#   6. DefenseFinder_overview.pdf
#   7. DefenseFinder_overview.png
############################################################


############################################################
# 1. OUTPUT DIRECTORY
############################################################

defence_output_directory <- "DefenseFinder_Overview"

dir.create(
  defence_output_directory,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


############################################################
# 2. CLEAN DEFENSEFINDER GENE–PROTEIN TABLE
############################################################

# DefenseFinder has already assigned these genes to predicted
# defence systems, so no antiSMASH-like region cleaning is needed.

defence_clean_gene_protein <- defence_gene_protein %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Defense_System_ID),
    Defense_System_ID != "",
    !is.na(Defense_Type),
    Defense_Type != "",
    !is.na(Protein_ID),
    Protein_ID != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Proteome_Detected =
      coalesce(Detected_In_Proteome, FALSE)
  ) %>%

  # Remove only repeated rows for the same protein assignment.
  # A protein assigned to two different systems remains in both.
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    Defense_System_ID,
    Defense_Type,
    Protein_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Species_ID,
    Defense_Type,
    Defense_System_ID,
    Protein_ID
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Group_For_Plots,

    Defense_System_ID,
    Defense_Type,
    Defense_Subtype,
    Defense_Gene,
    Protein_ID,

    Proteome_Detected,
    N_Dates_Detected,
    Mean_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
    Max_Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,

    Gene_Annotation_Matched,
    Contig_ID,

    KEGG_ID,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    KEGG_Category,
    KEGG_Subcategory_ID,
    KEGG_Subcategory
  )


############################################################
# 3. ONE ROW PER DEFENCE SYSTEM
############################################################

defence_system_overview <- defence_clean_gene_protein %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Group_For_Plots,
    Defense_System_ID,
    Defense_Type,
    Defense_Subtype
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Defense_Proteins =
      n_distinct(Protein_ID),

    N_Detected_Defense_Proteins =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[Proteome_Detected]
      ),

    Any_Component_Detected =
      N_Detected_Defense_Proteins > 0,

    All_Components_Detected =
      N_Defense_Proteins > 0 &
      N_Detected_Defense_Proteins == N_Defense_Proteins,

    Percent_Components_Detected =
      100 *
      N_Detected_Defense_Proteins /
      N_Defense_Proteins,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
# 4. ONE ROW PER MAG
############################################################

# Number of systems that have entries in the gene inventory.
inventory_systems_per_mag <- defence_system_overview %>%
  group_by(Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Systems_With_Gene_Rows =
      n_distinct(Defense_System_ID),

    N_Systems_With_Any_Protein_Detected =
      n_distinct(
        Defense_System_ID[Any_Component_Detected]
      ),

    N_Systems_With_All_Proteins_Detected =
      n_distinct(
        Defense_System_ID[All_Components_Detected]
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# The summary table remains authoritative for the predicted
# number of systems because it contains all 170 MAGs.
defence_mag_overview <- analysis_species %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Group_For_Plots
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    defence %>%
      distinct(Species_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      select(
        Species_ID,
        Has_Defense_System,
        N_Defense_Systems
      ),

    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    inventory_systems_per_mag,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Has_Defense_System =
      coalesce(Has_Defense_System, FALSE),

    N_Predicted_Defense_Systems =
      replace_na(N_Defense_Systems, 0),

    across(
      c(
        N_Systems_With_Gene_Rows,
        N_Systems_With_Any_Protein_Detected,
        N_Systems_With_All_Proteins_Detected
      ),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -N_Defense_Systems
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    desc(N_Predicted_Defense_Systems),
    Species_ID
  )


############################################################
# 5. CHECK SUMMARY VERSUS GENE INVENTORY
############################################################

defence_count_audit <- tibble(
  Source = c(
    "DefenseFinder species summary",
    "Unique system IDs in gene inventory"
  ),

  N_Systems = c(
    sum(
      defence_mag_overview$N_Predicted_Defense_Systems
    ),

    sum(
      defence_mag_overview$N_Systems_With_Gene_Rows
    )
  )
)


defence_system_count_discrepancies <-
  defence_mag_overview %>%
  filter(
    N_Predicted_Defense_Systems !=
      N_Systems_With_Gene_Rows
  ) %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    N_Predicted_Defense_Systems,
    N_Systems_With_Gene_Rows
  )


defence_count_audit
defence_system_count_discrepancies


############################################################
# 6. GROUP-LEVEL OVERVIEW
############################################################

defence_group_overview <- defence_mag_overview %>%
  group_by(Trophic_Strategy) %>%
  summarise(
    N_MAGs = n(),

    N_MAGs_With_Defense =
      sum(N_Predicted_Defense_Systems > 0),

    Percent_MAGs_With_Defense =
      100 *
      N_MAGs_With_Defense /
      N_MAGs,

    Total_Predicted_Systems =
      sum(N_Predicted_Defense_Systems),

    Median_Systems_Per_MAG =
      median(N_Predicted_Defense_Systems),

    N_MAGs_With_Detected_Defense_Protein =
      sum(
        N_Systems_With_Any_Protein_Detected > 0
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

defence_group_overview


############################################################
# 7. RECOVER DEFENCE-TYPE COUNTS FROM THE SPECIES SUMMARY
############################################################

# The summary stores type-specific system counts in columns such
# as N_Type_AbiE, N_Type_RM_Type_I and N_Type_CBASS.
#
# Construct a lookup restoring the exact Defense_Type labels
# used in the gene inventory.

defence_type_lookup <- defence_clean_gene_protein %>%
  distinct(Defense_Type) %>%
  mutate(
    Defense_Type_Key =
      str_replace_all(
        Defense_Type,
        "[^A-Za-z0-9_]",
        "_"
      )
  )


if (
  nrow(defence_type_lookup) !=
    n_distinct(defence_type_lookup$Defense_Type_Key)
) {
  stop(
    "Multiple Defense_Type values map to the same summary-column key."
  )
}


defence_type_by_mag <- defence %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    matches("^N_Type_")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^N_Type_"),
    names_to = "Defense_Type_Key",
    names_prefix = "N_Type_",
    values_to = "N_Systems_Of_Type"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    N_Systems_Of_Type =
      replace_na(N_Systems_Of_Type, 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    N_Systems_Of_Type > 0
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    defence_type_lookup,
    by = "Defense_Type_Key"
  )


if (any(is.na(defence_type_by_mag$Defense_Type))) {
  stop(
    "At least one DefenseFinder summary type could not be matched ",
    "to a Defense_Type in the gene inventory."
  )
}


############################################################
# 8. PREPARE PANEL A
############################################################

defence_per_mag <- defence_mag_overview %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy,
    N_Predicted_Defense_Systems
  )


group_sizes <- defence_per_mag %>%
  count(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    name = "N_MAGs"
  )


# Expected: 62, 94 and 14; total = 170.
group_sizes
sum(group_sizes$N_MAGs)


trophic_axis_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(
    as.character(group_sizes$Trophic_Strategy),
    "\n(n = ",
    group_sizes$N_MAGs,
    " MAGs)"
  ),

  as.character(group_sizes$Trophic_Strategy)
)


############################################################
# 9. PREPARE PANEL B: TYPE PREVALENCE
############################################################

# System and MAG counts come from the species summary.
defence_type_counts <- defence_type_by_mag %>%
  group_by(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Defense_Type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Systems =
      sum(N_Systems_Of_Type),

    N_MAGs_With_Type =
      n_distinct(Species_ID),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Protein counts come from the gene–proteome table.
defence_type_protein_counts <-
  defence_clean_gene_protein %>%
  group_by(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Defense_Type
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Retained_Defense_Proteins =
      n_distinct(Protein_ID),

    N_Detected_Defense_Proteins =
      n_distinct(
        Protein_ID[Proteome_Detected]
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


defence_type_counts <- defence_type_counts %>%
  left_join(
    defence_type_protein_counts,
    by = c(
      "Trophic_Strategy",
      "Defense_Type"
    )
  )


# Explicitly create all group × type combinations so absent
# types receive zero rather than disappearing from the plot.
all_defence_type_combinations <- expand_grid(
  Trophic_Strategy = trophic_levels,

  Defense_Type = sort(
    unique(defence_type_counts$Defense_Type)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Trophic_Strategy = factor(
      Trophic_Strategy,
      levels = trophic_levels
    )
  )


defence_type_prevalence <-
  all_defence_type_combinations %>%
  left_join(
    defence_type_counts,
    by = c(
      "Trophic_Strategy",
      "Defense_Type"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    group_sizes,
    by = "Trophic_Strategy"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        N_Systems,
        N_MAGs_With_Type,
        N_Retained_Defense_Proteins,
        N_Detected_Defense_Proteins
      ),
      ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
    ),

    Percent_MAGs_With_Type =
      100 *
      N_MAGs_With_Type /
      N_MAGs,

    # Example: (2/200) means that 2 of 200 unique defence
    # proteins assigned to this type were detected.
    Protein_Detection_Label = if_else(
      N_MAGs_With_Type > 0,
      paste0(
        "(",
        N_Detected_Defense_Proteins,
        "/",
        N_Retained_Defense_Proteins,
        ")"
      ),
      ""
    ),

    Protein_Label_Position =
      Percent_MAGs_With_Type + 1
  )


# Rarest types first so that the most prevalent appear at the
# top after coord_flip().
defence_type_order <- defence_type_prevalence %>%
  group_by(Defense_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_MAGs_With_Type =
      sum(N_MAGs_With_Type),

    Total_Systems =
      sum(N_Systems),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Total_MAGs_With_Type,
    Total_Systems
  ) %>%
  pull(Defense_Type)


defence_type_prevalence <-
  defence_type_prevalence %>%
  mutate(
    Defense_Type = factor(
      Defense_Type,
      levels = defence_type_order
    )
  )


############################################################
# 10. EXPORT CLEAN TABLES
############################################################

write_csv(
  defence_clean_gene_protein,
  file.path(
    defence_output_directory,
    "DefenseFinder_gene_protein_clean.csv"
  )
)


write_csv(
  defence_system_overview,
  file.path(
    defence_output_directory,
    "DefenseFinder_system_overview.csv"
  )
)


write_csv(
  defence_mag_overview,
  file.path(
    defence_output_directory,
    "DefenseFinder_MAG_overview.csv"
  )
)


write_csv(
  defence_type_prevalence,
  file.path(
    defence_output_directory,
    "DefenseFinder_type_prevalence.csv"
  )
)


write_csv(
  defence_system_count_discrepancies,
  file.path(
    defence_output_directory,
    "DefenseFinder_count_discrepancies.csv"
  )
)


############################################################
# 11. PANEL A: DEFENCE SYSTEMS PER MAG
############################################################

maximum_systems <- max(
  defence_per_mag$N_Predicted_Defense_Systems,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


plot_defence_per_mag <- ggplot(
  defence_per_mag,
  aes(
    x = Trophic_Strategy,
    y = N_Predicted_Defense_Systems,
    fill = Trophic_Strategy
  )
) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = TRUE,
    scale = "width",
    adjust = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.75,
    colour = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.13,
    height = 0.10,
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.7,
    stroke = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.70,
    colour = "grey20"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = trophic_cols
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = trophic_axis_labels
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 8),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.02, 0.08)
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(
      -0.5,
      maximum_systems + 2
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title =
      "A   Predicted DefenseFinder systems per MAG",

    subtitle =
      "Dots represent individual MAGs; white diamonds show medians",

    x = NULL,

    y =
      "Number of predicted defence systems"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 10
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "panel",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 8,
      colour = "grey30"
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 9.5
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 8.5
    )
  )


############################################################
# 12. PANEL B: DEFENCE-TYPE PREVALENCE
############################################################

plot_defence_prevalence <- ggplot(
  defence_type_prevalence,
  aes(
    x = Defense_Type,
    y = Percent_MAGs_With_Type,
    fill = Trophic_Strategy
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge2(
      width = 0.82,
      preserve = "single",
      padding = 0.16
    ),
    width = 0.64,
    colour = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.20
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = Protein_Label_Position,
      label = Protein_Detection_Label
    ),
    position = position_dodge2(
      width = 0.82,
      preserve = "single",
      padding = 0.16
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 1.9,
    colour = "grey15",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_flip(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = trophic_cols
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = function(x) {
      str_replace_all(x, "_", "-")
    }
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 125),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title =
      "B   Prevalence of DefenseFinder system types",

    subtitle = paste(
      "Bars show MAG prevalence;",
      "labels show detected/retained defence-associated proteins"
    ),

    x = NULL,
    y = "MAG prevalence",
    fill = "Trophic strategy"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 10
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "panel",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 8,
      colour = "grey30"
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 9.5
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 6
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    legend.key.size = grid::unit(
      0.42,
      "cm"
    ),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      colour = "grey92",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      5.5,
      20,
      5.5,
      5.5
    )
  )


############################################################
# 13. COMBINE AND EXPORT
############################################################

defence_overview_figure <- (
  plot_defence_per_mag |
    plot_defence_prevalence
) +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.80, 1.80),
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    title =
      "Antiphage defence-system potential across trophic strategies",

    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 13
      )
    )
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )


defence_overview_figure


# DefenseFinder contains substantially more types than antiSMASH.
# The export height therefore increases automatically.
n_defence_types <- n_distinct(
  defence_type_prevalence$Defense_Type
)

defence_figure_height <- max(
  10,
  3.2 + 0.16 * n_defence_types
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    defence_output_directory,
    "DefenseFinder_overview.pdf"
  ),
  plot = defence_overview_figure,
  width = 14,
  height = defence_figure_height,
  units = "in"
)


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    defence_output_directory,
    "DefenseFinder_overview.png"
  ),
  plot = defence_overview_figure,
  width = 14,
  height = defence_figure_height,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)

############################################################
# SOURCE DATA — SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 40
############################################################

source_dir <- paste0(
  "C:/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/",
  "DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Source_Data_Supplement"
)


# ============================================================
# Figure 40a — predicted defence systems per MAG
# ============================================================

Suppl_Figure_40a <- defence_per_mag %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Strategy = as.character(Trophic_Strategy),
    N_Predicted_Defense_Systems
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Trophic_Strategy,
    Species_ID
  )

readr::write_csv(
  Suppl_Figure_40a,
  file.path(
    source_dir,
    "Suppl_Figure_40a.csv"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Figure 40b — prevalence of DefenseFinder system types
# ============================================================

Suppl_Figure_40b <- defence_type_prevalence %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Defense_Type = as.character(Defense_Type),
    Trophic_Strategy = as.character(Trophic_Strategy),
    N_MAGs_Total = N_MAGs,
    N_MAGs_With_Type,
    Percent_MAGs_With_Type,
    N_Detected_Defense_Proteins,
    N_Retained_Defense_Proteins
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Defense_Type,
    Trophic_Strategy
  )

readr::write_csv(
  Suppl_Figure_40b,
  file.path(
    source_dir,
    "Suppl_Figure_40b.csv"
  )
)
```
